stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def comps(g,bg):
    R,C=g.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); out=[]
    for i in range(R):
        for j in range(C):
            if g[i,j]!=bg and not seen[i,j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; cs=[]; col=set()
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop()
                    if y<0 or x<0 or y>=R or x>=C: continue
                    if seen[y,x] or g[y,x]==bg: continue
                    seen[y,x]=True; col.add(int(g[y,x])); cs.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        st.append((y+dy,x+dx))
                ys=[a for a,b in cs]; xs=[b for a,b in cs]
                h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; w=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
                n=len(cs)
                # outline cells vs holes
                interior={(y,x) for y in range(min(ys),max(ys)+1) for x in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1)} - set(cs)
                # check it's a box: all border cells present
                ok=all(g[min(ys)+dy][min(xs)+dx]!=bg for dy in (0,h-1) for dx in (0,w-1)) if False else None
                isbox=n==2*(h+w)-4
                fill={int(do2) for r in range(g.shape[0]) for c in range(g.shape[1]) for do2 in []}
                out.append((h,w,isbox,col,set(int(t[1]) for t in [g[r,c] for r,c in interior])))
    return out
